title: Retrieve tote exchange settings using the Tote Management API (Get Exchange Settings)
summary: Use the Totes Aveva API page (API Features for Tote Management) to retrieve tote exchange settings/configurations via the “Get Exchange Settings” function and confirm the API returns exchange configuration data.
when_to_use: When you need to retrieve the current tote exchange settings/configurations from the Tote Management API using the “Get Exchange Settings” function.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the API retrieval on the Totes Aveva API page and capture the returned exchange settings/configurations as displayed in the API response area.
safety_notes: Do not bypass the supported control layer; use the exposed API functions rather than attempting direct database access (the source emphasizes not bypassing the official software/API layer).
